question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**troubles**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage discusses the importance of staying away from problems as one matures and takes on responsibilities.
 
• The phrase "keeping out of troubles" fits the context because it indicates avoiding difficulties that can hinder personal growth.
 
• Other options ("beats", "touches", and "disturbs") do not convey the intended meaning of avoiding problems or obstacles.
